{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows where either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g is missing
complete_data = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Compute the Pearson correlation between flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g
correlation = complete_data['flipper_length_mm'].corr(complete_data['body_mass_g'])

# Print ONLY the correlation value, as required
print(correlation)"}
